summary: scripts/st-test signs linux-clippy by default, from linux-gate's own clippy stage when linux-gate runs (clippy runs once) or from the stage run alone; the note records scripts/ci-clippy-result, which fails when the stage's compiles or workspace build scripts read a repository file outside linux-clippy's input key, and carries the key so a tree with the same key reuses it; linux-gate keeps its clippy stage while linux-clippy is in shadow

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes; local linux-clippy notes record run_command_sha256 and source_inputs, as rust-tests' notes do.

rules.detail: Still shadow: the linux-clippy gate never says skip while enforce is false. linux-clippy's host, agent and queue levels now hold a note to python3 scripts/ci-clippy-result and require run_command_sha256. CI's linux-clippy job fails, no longer only warns, when its compiles read a file outside the key; every local run now checks the same before the merge queue does.

compatibility.detail: The caller's command is unchanged (scripts/st-test --all --push origin). linux-gate's notes and command are unchanged. Local linux-clippy notes signed with the old opt-in command no longer match its policy, and are measured again.

recovery.detail: Revert the change; linux-clippy returns to an opt-in local check and its dep-info check to a warning.
